tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: All cave diving regions with their country, number of caves, maximum depth and page address. Filter by country (ISO code or name).

tools.name: search_caves
tools.description: Find caves by name (also other spellings), region, country, maximum depth or the certification level a team has. Returns a short line per cave with its page; use get_cave for the details and warnings.

tools.name: get_cave
tools.description: Everything the cave's public page says: depth, certification level, configurations, access, the story, warnings, closure, water temperature, who guides there, fill stations nearby and sources.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: A region's practical information (rules, fees, emergency numbers, gas), travel advisory, its dive centres, instructors and fill stations with their services, and the list of its caves.

tools.name: current_conditions
tools.description: What is known about a cave right now: visibility reported by divers (last 14 days, else the latest up to 60 days), river flow and level with a visibility estimate where the cave has a gauge, rain of the past 7 days, and tropical storms nearby. Updated once a day.

tools.name: check_team
tools.description: The same check as the trip planner: for each cave of a region (or the given caves), whether the whole team can dive it, only partly, or not, with the reasons and the warnings that apply to them.
